x: On May 25th, at the White City, was held the 4 x 220 yds. and we fielded a useful team in Kealey, Stroud, Mewes and Michael. Kealey elected to start for us, and drawing number 1 station, he was twice bumped very badly and so we lost any advantage which we might have had.
Unfortunately, and I say that advisedly, we were without the sprinters we had been relying upon, and so our team for the 4 x 100 was Mewes, Bennet, Michael and Camkin.
We (the Belgrave Harriers) would also like to see some of the older members back in training, such as Messrs. Bone, Mewes, Kealey and Co. The Club has many promising juniors also.
Skelley, Mewes, Pritchard and Blunden, who formed the team. (Congratulations also to Skelley on having his shorts passed by a Southern A.A.A. representative!).
A Belgrave team of Dyke, Bone and Mewes was entered. Evidently it was a regular race as previous times of 10.8 etc are given and winners had been Poly and Blackheath.
